title: WhiteboardRegistry::archive bypasses the Role::can_transition authority gate
wanted_capability: archive() should enforce the same role authority gate as transition(): Resolve→Archived is a phase transition, so only facilitator/operator roles may perform it. Today src/whiteboards.rs:1048 archive() checks only registration + phase==Resolve, while transition() enforces agent.role.can_transition() at :1023 — any registered agent can archive a board, violating the archive authority contract (RAP-WB-001..003, plan at design/refactor/plans/rap-wb-archive-role.md). Verified still present 2026-06-11.
missing_primitive: Role::can_transition() check inside WhiteboardRegistry::archive (and the whiteboard_archive tool path that calls it directly)
notes: This is the real bug the arch-pathology-rust PE-6 run found (its plan subject). Extracted from thread-cc07f395 item 7 during thread triage.
resolution_note: implemented in commit 1ac3814e: Role::can_transition() now guards both archive paths (force relaxes only the phase precondition, preserving 80794d55 semantics); specialist non-force refusal test added. Merged at ae68cace, cluster gates green (bbox-verify-7bv6c), deployed in image ae68cace48bf. Operator-approved closure 2026-08-18.
